rows.name: ocApplySequenceCuts
rows.replacement_plan: Port the common ripple-delete path onto createRemoveItemsAction and verify it with the existing host-write read-back contract; cover advanced trim edge cases in F267 UDT before dropping the CEP fallback.
rows.role: Remove or trim timeline ranges and ripple-delete where requested.
rows.uxp_path: SequenceEditor.getEditor(sequence).createRemoveItemsAction(trackItemSelection, ripple, mediaType, shiftOverLapping?) -> Action (confirmed 2026-08-20 in @adobe/premierepro 26.3.0 typings, src/premierepro.d.ts:3203-3232). Run through Project.executeTransaction so the edit is undoable and its effect is observable — preferred over sequence.rippleDelete(), which premiere-pro-mcp #21 measured returning success while changing nothing on 26.3.

rows.name: ocApplyClipKeyframes

rows.role: Apply opacity, scale, position, or other keyframe payloads to clips.
rows.uxp_path: Component and property keyframe APIs on UXP clip items.

rows.name: ocBatchRenameProjectItems
rows.replacement_plan: Treat as low-priority convenience wiring in the UXP bridge.
rows.role: Rename selected project items in bulk.

rows.name: ocCreateSmartBins
rows.replacement_plan: Move bin creation behind the UXP project bridge.
rows.role: Create bins for organized project-item workflows.
rows.uxp_path: Project root item and bin creation APIs.

rows.name: ocAddNativeCaptionTrack
rows.replacement_plan: Keep CEP fallback while available; prioritize F253 Hybrid Plugin caption-track creation or adopt an Adobe UXP API if it ships. Until then the supported UXP-era path is exporting the SRT sidecar for manual import.
rows.role: Create a native Premiere caption track from SRT-style segments.
rows.uxp_path: No UXP caption-track write API as of 26.3 (audited 2026-08-20 against @adobe/premierepro 26.3.0 typings). CaptionTrack exposes only getCaptionTrackCount, getCaptionTrack(index), createSetNameAction, and setMute — read, rename, and mute. Transcript.createImportTextSegmentsAction targets a ClipProjectItem transcript, which is a different object from a sequence caption track and is not a substitute.

rows.name: ocQeReflect
rows.replacement_plan: Retire QE reflection after CEP EOL rather than seeking a successor; replace any real workflow that depends on it one by one with documented UXP APIs and F267 UDT evidence.
rows.role: Reflect undocumented QE DOM methods for diagnostics.
rows.uxp_path: No supported UXP QE DOM equivalent (audited 2026-08-20 against @adobe/premierepro 26.3.0 typings: no qe, reflect, executeScript, or evalScript surface exists). QE reflection is a CEP/ExtendScript debug facility, not a user feature, so it retires rather than ports.

rows.name: ocReadPanelBootstrapToken
rows.replacement_plan: Keep the secret contract identical and swap only the file-read transport when CEP retires.
rows.role: Read the local CSRF bootstrap secret so a file:// panel can prove it is host-embedded and not a web page.
rows.uxp_path: UXP reads the same secret through its own localFileSystem permission; no ExtendScript bridge is involved.
